intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Trump warns Iran over reported bomb plot
items.text: At his first news conference since returning from Asia, US President Donald Trump warned Iran over a reported plot against Washington. He said that if Iran carries it out, "we're going to fight". He added that his administration is watching Tehran closely and has extensive intelligence. Mr Trump also said a wave of banking, technology and service outages had separate causes. Meanwhile, Iran's foreign minister has said the US naval blockade must end before Iran can restart its oil exports.

gloss.plot: a secret plan to do something harmful
gloss.outage: a period when a service stops working
gloss.blockade: the use of ships to stop people or goods entering or leaving a place
gloss.intelligence: secret information about an enemy or a threat
gloss.close: careful and detailed, as in watching someone closely

items.title: Denmark expels Russian defence attaché
items.text: Denmark has ordered a Russian defence attaché to leave the country within seven days. Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen called the move a strong signal to Moscow. Denmark will also stop non-essential visas for Russians and discuss wider visa limits with its Schengen partners. Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said Danish authorities had linked a foiled plot to kill a US-Ukrainian citizen to Russian intelligence. Denmark will not expel all Russian diplomats.

gloss.expel: to officially force someone to leave a country
gloss.attaché: an official who works at an embassy and has a special job, such as defence
gloss.diplomat: an official who represents their country abroad

items.title: UK and EU agree closer security links
items.text: The UK and the European Union held their second annual summit in Brussels. Both sides agreed to deepen cooperation on security, defence, youth mobility and migration. The UK will also take part more regularly in EU civilian missions.

gloss.summit: an important meeting between leaders or senior officials
gloss.deepen: to make something stronger or closer
gloss.youth mobility: a scheme that lets young people live and work in another country for a time
gloss.civilian mission: an overseas project run by non-military staff

items.title: UEFA fines FA over England fans' chants
items.text: UEFA has fined the English Football Association €15,000 for racist or discriminatory behaviour by England fans. The incident happened at a Nations League match in Madrid, which England won 3-2 against Spain. UEFA also banned the sale of tickets to England fans for one away national-team match. This ban is suspended for two years. British media reported that the chants were anti-Catholic and anti-Irish.

gloss.fine: to make someone pay money as a punishment
gloss.discriminatory: treating a group of people unfairly because of who they are
gloss.suspended: officially delayed and only applied if the rules are broken again
gloss.probation: a period when someone must behave well or face a punishment
gloss.chant: a word or phrase shouted again and again by a crowd

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is out at last
items.text: Rockstar Games has announced that Grand Theft Auto VI is now available. The game launched on 19 November 2026 after a long wait. PlayStation players could pre-load it on PS5 from 10 November. A last-minute PS5 software update was needed to play it. Reports described gamers taking time off work to play on launch day.

gloss.launch: to release a product to the public for the first time
gloss.delay: a period when something happens later than planned
gloss.pre-load: to download a game before its release date so you can play at once
gloss.take time off: to be away from work for a short period
gloss.last-minute: done at the final moment before something happens

items.title: GTA VI sales near $4bn in a day
items.text: Deadline has reported that Grand Theft Auto VI sales came close to $4bn on its first day. The figure shows how much demand there was for the game after a 13-year wait since the previous main title. Deadline described it as a very large first day.

gloss.demand: how much people want to buy something
gloss.campaign: a planned set of activities to promote something
gloss.release: the date when a product becomes available to the public
gloss.industry watcher: a person who follows and comments on a business sector

items.title: Signal limits screenshots to block AI tools
items.text: The messaging app Signal is restricting screenshots on mobile devices. The aim is to stop AI assistants built into phone software from capturing private messages. Signal president Meredith Whittaker said agentic AI integrations are making the environment increasingly hostile to privacy. Screenshots are blocked on iOS 27, and AI screen capture is limited on supported Android devices. Users can switch the setting off, but Signal warned that this puts their messages at risk.

gloss.capture: to record or copy what is on a screen
gloss.integration: a feature that is built into another system
gloss.switch off: to turn a setting or device off

items.title: Pill shrinks pancreatic tumours in early trial
items.text: An early trial of a daily pill called daraxonrasib has shown promising results in advanced pancreatic cancer. Patients took it together with chemotherapy. Tumours shrank in 60.7% of the 61 patients, and five had no detectable tumours. Researchers said larger studies are needed before any firm conclusions can be drawn.

gloss.trial: a test of a new treatment on patients
gloss.tumour: a lump of cells growing in the body
gloss.detectable: able to be found or measured

items.title: Christie's pulls Frida Kahlo painting
items.text: Christie's has withdrawn a 1952 Frida Kahlo painting from a sale in New York. Mexico asked for more information about who owns the work and where it came from. The Frida Kahlo Museum in Mexico City said the painting is part of an ongoing investigation involving several works. The estimate was between $2.5m and $3.5m. Christie's and the seller agreed to withdraw it for more research and hope to offer it later.

gloss.withdraw: to take something back or remove it
gloss.provenance: the history of who has owned a work of art
gloss.estimate: a rough guess of the price something will sell for
gloss.seller: the person or company selling something

items.title: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 jobs at main hubs
items.text: Lufthansa plans to cut 1,000 full-time jobs at its hubs in Frankfurt and Munich. The airline will also reduce short- and medium-haul capacity. It reported an operating loss of €180m in the first nine months of 2026. A hub is a main airport where an airline connects many routes.

gloss.hub: a main airport where many flights connect
gloss.capacity: the number of seats or flights an airline offers
gloss.operating loss: money lost from running the main business, before some other costs
gloss.short-haul: a flight over a short distance
